payload.title: Consume shared Chatticus chat presentation in the newsroom console
payload.description:
As a signed-in editor, I want the newsroom console to consume the shared Chatticus chat surface so that chat UI is reused without cloning an agent engine.

Feature: Shared newsroom chat presentation
  Scenario: Render an editorial conversation
    Given a signed-in editor has an active console conversation
    When the newsroom renders its messages using the shared package
    Then the editor sees their conversation and can send a message once
    And Papyrus retains its current auth and editorial context adapter
  Scenario: Preserve host context actions
    Given a console conversation includes a Papyrus navigation action
    When the editor selects that action
    Then Papyrus handles the navigation without a Chatticus product dependency

First slice of PPY-a438d0 / PPY-7962e3. Chatticus tracking: chatticus-abde29 / chatticus-080b0e. UI/client extraction is independent of the later server-runtime migration. Shared server, per-editor isolation and delegated tools remain separate acceptance gates. No deployment or registry publication authorized.
